Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
select count(*) into :stops.note from dual where dummy = :stops.stop_id;
route_next(:stops.city);
execute_trigger('check_stop');
execute_trigger('REFRESH_STOP');
execute_trigger('LOG_ROUTE');

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_name varchar2(30) := 'LEGS';
BEGIN
 :global.route_user := user;
 :distance := 0;
 message(:city);
 :stops.city := :parameter.p_city;
 message(:parameter.p_none);
 message(:nowhere.city);
 message(:stops.nothing);
 message(:system.cursor_item);
 go_block('LEGS');
 go_item('LEGS.DISTANCE');
 go_item('distance');
 execute_trigger('CHECK_STOP');
 call_form('route_view');
 call_form('/forms/route_view.fmx');
 call_form('ROUTE_GONE');
 go_block(v_name);
 go_item(v_name);
 execute_trigger(v_name);
 call_form(v_name);
 execute_trigger('REFRESH_STOP');
 execute_trigger('LOG_ROUTE');
END;
